data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description: <p><strong>1 big thing:</strong> Axios is a growth-focused media company helping people get smarter, faster, on what matters. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer—a senior, hands-on individual contributor—to lead architecture and delivery for Axios’ core products across multiple teams using strong product-engineering and AI-native practices.</p> <p><strong>Why it matters:</strong> Axios delivers clear, trustworthy news to millions of readers. You’ll be anchored to a product area while shaping full-stack systems and technical direction across multiple teams and connected systems. This is not a people-management role.</p> <p>AI is core to how we build. You’ll use coding agents throughout implementation, testing, review, debugging, documentation, and operations while remaining accountable for architecture, quality, security, and product outcomes. Staff impact comes from sustained scope, judgment, and results—not tool use alone.</p> <p>You’ll work with product managers, designers, engineers, and leaders to shape plans, align dependencies, resolve ambiguity, build resilient systems, and help others make better technical decisions.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p>As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll lead reliable product and platform work across Axios’ frontend and backend systems. You’ll remain hands-on while driving multi-quarter initiatives, improving technical coherence, and using agentic practices to accelerate delivery. Key responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Cross-team technical leadership:</strong> Lead mission-critical or high-risk initiatives spanning teams and connected systems. Frame problems, align ownership and dependencies, make tradeoffs explicit, and drive production adoption.</li> <li><strong>Architecture and design:</strong> Own architecture for a product area and scalable boundaries across frontend, APIs, data, and production systems. Lead design reviews and establish standards within your sphere of influence.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on system ownership:</strong> Own the technical direction and long-term evolution of key systems while writing and reviewing code, prototyping, debugging, leading migrations, and operating services in production.</li> <li><strong>AI-enabled product and engineering:</strong> Identify where models, agents, retrieval, or automation create value. Build reusable capabilities with measurable behavior, guardrails, and judgment about when conventional software is better.</li> <li><strong>Quality, reliability, and incident leadership:</strong> Improve testing, performance, observability, security, and operational readiness. Anticipate systemic risks, address technical debt, and help lead resolution and learning during critical production issues.</li> <li><strong>Technical leadership and mentorship:</strong> Mentor mid- and senior-level engineers across teams, spread systems thinking and design patterns, and build alignment through proposals, reviews, and influence without authority.</li> <li><strong>Product and technical strategy:</strong> Partner with product, design, and engineering leaders to shape the product-area roadmap, align dependencies, and connect technical investment to reader, editorial, and business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills:</strong></p> <p>The ideal candidate is a staff-level engineer with sustained multi-team impact, deep expertise in a relevant domain, broad systems thinking, and a commitment to user experience, reliability, scalability, maintainable code, and effective AI-enabled practice. You should have:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> Typically 7+ years in professional software development, or equivalent sustained Staff-level impact, including leading complex initiatives across multiple teams or systems.</li> <li><strong>AI-native development:</strong> Hands-on experience using agentic coding tools—such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools—to complete meaningful, multi-step software work, rather than only generating snippets or using autocomplete.</li> <li><strong>Agent direction and context:</strong> Ability to write clear strategies, specifications, and acceptance criteria; provide context; scope complex work; decide what to delegate; and redirect incomplete or incorrect approaches.</li> <li><strong>Verification and engineering judgment:</strong> Ability to review AI-generated code critically, validate assumptions, identify security, scalability, and maintainability risks, and catch plausible but wrong solutions. You understand that AI raises the importance of sound architecture, testing, and human judgment.</li> <li><strong>Frontend development:</strong> Hands-on experience building production interfaces with JavaScript or TypeScript and React, preferably with Next.js, plus judgment to guide frontend architecture across teams.</li> <li><strong>Backend development:</strong> Hands-on experience building production services and APIs. Our backend systems use Go and Python, and you should be able to shape reliable service boundaries and work effectively in or learn either language.</li> <li><strong>Data fundamentals:</strong> Experience with relational databases, SQL, schema design, transactions, and migrations.</li> <li><strong>Quality and security:</strong> Experience with testing, accessibility, input validation, authentication, authorization, and web security practices, plus the ability to raise standards across teams.</li> <li><strong>Engineering judgment:</strong> Ability to operate independently in ambiguity, identify high-leverage problems, align teams, make sound tradeoffs, and connect decisions to product and business goals—including when AI is not the right tool.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Ability to build alignment through clear proposals and reasoning, communicate risks and tradeoffs across functions, and drive clarity during disagreement.</li> <li><strong>Continuous learning:</strong> Curiosity about changing models, tools, and practices, paired with an evidence-based approach. You share useful patterns, identify what fails, and make others more effective.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We’ll be even more excited if you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building production AI-enabled features using model APIs, structured outputs, tool or function calling, retrieval, or agent workflows.</li> <li>Experience evaluating and operating AI-enabled systems through regression tests, evaluation harnesses, tracing, feedback loops, model or prompt versioning, cost and latency monitoring, or human-review paths.</li> <li>Experience extending AI development environments through MCP servers, agent tools, repository instructions, reusable skills or plugins, custom workflows, or automated code review.</li> <li>Led a multi-team architecture, platform, migration, or modernization initiative from problem framing through production adoption.</li> <li>Owned critical systems through incidents, scaling challenges, and long-term architectural evolution.</li> <li>Drove adoption of technical standards, reusable tools, or platform capabilities across multiple teams.</li> <li>Mentored experienced engineers and helped improve technical judgment beyond your immediate team.</li> <li>Experience with CMS, publishing, media, subscription, search, or other consumer-facing products.</li> <li>Production experience with Go or Python and distributed systems using gRPC, cloud infrastructure, containers, queues, CI/CD, or similar technologies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What success looks like:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Cross-team delivery:</strong> You drive multi-quarter initiatives from problem framing through production adoption, aligning dependencies and ownership to produce durable outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Engineering leverage:</strong> Teams deliver more effectively because of the standards, tools, architecture, documentation, and context you create. You establish safe, repeatable AI patterns where they add value.</li> <li><strong>System health:</strong> Key systems become more reliable, scalable, secure, observable, and easier to change. You reduce systemic risk and improve incident prevention and response.</li> <li><strong>Product-area impact:</strong> Your decisions support Axios’ readers, products, editorial workflows, and business goals within the teams and systems you influence.</li> <li><strong>Organizational technical leadership:</strong> Engineers across teams make better decisions through your mentorship, proposals, reviews, and example. You remain a hands-on IC who multiplies others’ effectiveness.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Starting salary for this role is in the range of $165,000 - $215,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account the cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.</em></p> <p>Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.<br><br></p> <p><strong>What Axios brings to the table besides salary:</strong></p> <ul> <li>401(k) with employer match</li> <li>Robust PPO and High Deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network</li> <li>Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high deductible health plan option</li> <li>Dental and vision coverage</li> <li>Primary caregiver 12-week paid leave</li> <li>Birth-givers will have an additional 6-8 weeks depending on type of delivery, for a total of 18-20 weeks continuous leave</li> <li>Generous vacation policy, plus holidays</li> <li>One mental health day per quarter</li> <li>Annual learning and development stipend</li> <li>$100 monthly work-from-home stipend</li> <li>Tele-mental health services through Headspace</li> <li>OneMedical membership, including tele-health services</li> <li>Personal health advocacy resources through HealthAdvocate</li> <li>Inclusive fertility, hormonal health and family forming benefits through Carrot Fertility</li> <li>Access to the Axios “Family Fund”, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies</li> <li>Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers</li> <li>Virtual company-sponsored social events</li> <li>A strong and positive work environment</li> <li>A commitment to an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer Statement&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Axios is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.&nbsp;</p> <p>This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Axios makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p>
data.summary: The Staff Software Engineer leads architecture, technical direction, and delivery for Axios’ core products across multiple teams while remaining a hands-on individual contributor. Responsibilities include building and operating frontend and backend systems, improving reliability and security, applying AI-enabled engineering practices, leading cross-team initiatives, and mentoring engineers.

data.title: Field Installation Technician
data.description:
Join Us as a Field Installation Technician!

Are you a hands-on technical professional who enjoys working directly with customers and technology in the field? ORBCOMM is seeking a Field Installation Technician to support the deployment, installation, training, and ongoing success of our telematics and hardware solutions. In this role, you will play a critical part in delivering high-quality installations, supporting new product rollouts, and helping customers and partners maximize the value of ORBCOMM technology.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

As a member of ORBCOMM’s Field Services organization, you will work closely with customers, installation partners, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams to ensure successful deployments across a wide range of fleet and telematics solutions. Reporting to the Field Installation Team Lead, you will contribute to installation excellence, customer enablement, field support, and continuous improvement initiatives that directly impact customer satisfaction and product adoption.


This role can be held remotely in Texas, Arkansas, or Oklahoma. This position averages 80 % travel.


What You’ll Do

Installation & Deployment

  • Perform field installations across ORBCOMM’s telematics, in-cab, and related hardware solutions.
  • Support pilot programs, large-scale deployments, and product rollouts.
  • Ensure installations are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with project timelines and service expectations.
  • Maintain consistency across installations while adhering to established standards and best practices.

Training & Customer Enablement

  • Deliver hands-on training to customers, partners, and third-party installers.
  • Demonstrate installation procedures, product functionality, and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Help drive successful adoption of ORBCOMM solutions through effective knowledge transfer and support.

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

  • Provide on-site and remote technical support during and after installations.
  • Diagnose and resolve hardware, wiring, connectivity, and installation-related issues.
  • Escalate and collaborate with internal teams as needed to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Maintain accurate installation records, field reports, and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with the development, review, validation, and continuous improvement of installation guides and technical materials.
  • Identify opportunities to improve installation processes, tools, and documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Engineering and Product teams to support new hardware introductions and product enhancements.
  • Provide field feedback to help improve products, installation methods, and customer experience.
  • Communicate regularly with Field Services, Customer Success, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders.


Who You Are

You are a technically skilled and customer-focused professional who thrives in field environments and takes pride in delivering quality work. You combine strong troubleshooting abilities with excellent communication skills and enjoy helping customers, partners, and installers succeed.

If you have:

  • 3–5+ years of experience in field installation, telematics, fleet technology, or a related technical field.
  • Hands-on experience with in-cab systems, telematics devices, fleet technology, or similar hardware solutions.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and attention to detail.
  • Experience reading and interpreting technical installation documentation and wiring diagrams.
  • Ability to troubleshoot hardware, wiring, and connectivity issues.
  • Experience working in field environments, including vehicles, depots, and customer locations.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to train, coach, and support customers, partners, or installers.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Preferred: Experience using mobile installation applications or field service tools.
  • Preferred: Familiarity with creating training materials, instructional content, or installation documentation.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
  • Commitment to quality, safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
  • Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

Additionally:

  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 lbs (23 kg) on a regular basis.
  • Ability to work in and around trucks, trailers, refrigerated units, and heavy equipment.
  • Ability to bend, kneel, crouch, crawl, reach, and climb while performing installations and troubleshooting.
  • Ability to work in tight or confined spaces, including under dashboards, inside cabs, and around equipment compartments.
  • Ability to use hand and power tools safely and effectively for extended periods.
  • Ability to stand, walk, and perform physical work for prolonged periods throughout the workday.
  • Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather and environmental conditions.
  • Ability to climb ladders and safely access installation locations at various heights when required.
  • Ability to travel frequently and operate a motor vehicle with a valid driver's license.


Then we want to meet you!



The Benefits of Working Here 
A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.


How We Hire

ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture.


About Us

At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www.orbcomm.com! 


Ready to Join Us?

We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you. 


We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.  


At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.
data.summary: ORBCOMM is seeking a Field Installation Technician to install, deploy, troubleshoot, and support telematics, in-cab, and related hardware solutions. The role includes customer and partner training, technical documentation, product rollout support, and collaboration with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams. It is remote within Texas, Arkansas, or Oklahoma and averages 80% travel.
